mechanisms.activator_translation: Every activation has a parent lineage; HOLD/REJECT/failure survive; repeated position without delta cannot be reported as progress.

observed_semantics: repository observation bound to exact commit
previous report is memory not independent evidence
secret-like paths and token patterns scrubbed
transport failure retained as constraint not target evidence
mechanisms.activator_translation: Stimulus/context packets must bind observations to source identity and must not promote inherited model memory into fresh evidence.

observed_semantics: deterministic repository snapshot may survive model synthesis failure
repository_snapshot model_synthesis and target_transport are separate health planes
model failure does not erase successful snapshot
mechanisms.activator_translation: Runtime health is a separate axis from epistemic state; degraded synthesis cannot erase already bound observations.
Use Demiurge only after routing selects dispatch; waking JANUS never implies a 17-agent run.
Multi-organ coordination may share state while preserving source identity and provenance.
TOPA is a promotion/falsification gate, not root wake authority.
